title: Soteria: Formally Verified Planning with Runtime Enforcement for Safe LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.17880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents that execute multi-step tool calls must satisfy two objectives simultaneously: completing the user's task (utility) and conforming to domain policies and correctness constraints (safety). These objectives are in tension -- blocking an unsafe action prevents a violation but can leave the agent stranded with no principled way to recover. Existing approaches sacrifice one objective for the other. We introduce Soteria, a framework that reconciles safety and utility through verified hierarchical planning and runtime enforcement of specifications. Before execution, the agent generates a structured plan that is formally verified against the specifications prior to any tool invocation. During execution, the verified plan serves dual roles: it ensures that the agent takes specification-conformant trajectories and provides guidance when unsafe actions are blocked. translated_title: Soteria：面向安全 LLM 智能体的形式化验证规划与运行时强制执行
translated_abstract: 执行多步骤工具调用的 LLM 智能体必须同时满足两个目标：完成用户的任务（效用）和遵守领域策略与正确性约束（安全）。这两个目标之间存在张力——阻止一个不安全的动作虽然可以防止违规，但可能使智能体陷入困境且缺乏有原则的恢复途径。现有方法往往牺牲其中一个目标来换取另一个。我们提出 Soteria，一个通过经过验证的分层规划和规范的运行时强制执行来调和安全与效用的框架。在执行之前，智能体生成一个结构化计划，并在任何工具调用之前针对规范对其进行形式化验证。在执行期间，经过验证的计划发挥双重作用：它确保智能体采取符合规范的轨迹，并在不安全动作被阻止时提供恢复指导。在涵盖多种工具使用任务的多个基准测试中……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Soteria 通过在工具调用前对分层计划进行形式化验证并在运行时强制执行规范，使 LLM 智能体在不牺牲任务效用的情况下保证安全性，并在不安全动作被阻止时借助已验证计划提供有原则的恢复指导。
en_tdlr: Soteria reconciles safety and utility for LLM agents by formally verifying hierarchical plans before execution and enforcing specifications at runtime, ensuring safe trajectories while providing principled recovery guidance when unsafe actions are blocked.
